what: Lost and Found Poster Maker creates a clear, eye-catching poster when you have lost a pet, an item or a vehicle, when someone is missing, or when you have found something and want the owner to get it back.

The poster has a bold headline, a big photo, a description, where and when it was last seen or found, an optional reward, your phone number in large type and a QR code that opens a call, a WhatsApp chat or a web page. Paper posters get tear-off strips with your number along the bottom.

Download an A4 or US Letter PDF to print, or a PNG sized for WhatsApp, social media feeds and stories. The printed words come in 12 languages, and Arabic and Urdu posters read right to left. Everything is made on your device.
uses: Put up LOST DOG or LOST CAT posters around your area within minutes.
Help a found animal get home with a FOUND poster.
Share a clear MISSING poster after you have contacted the police.
Wallets, phones, keys, bags and documents.
Ask neighbours to look out for your bicycle, scooter or car.
Post the PNG on WhatsApp, Facebook groups and neighbourhood apps.
tutorial: Tap Lost or Found, then what it is: pet, person, item or vehicle.
Choose a colour style and the language for the printed words, and the size: A4, US Letter, a square or portrait post, or a story.
Choose a clear, recent photo. Pick "Fill the box" or "Show the whole photo".
Type the animal, name or item, a description, where it was last seen or found, the date and time, and a reward if you offer one.
Type your phone number with the country code and your name. Choose whether the QR code starts a call, a WhatsApp chat or opens a web page.
For paper posters choose 6, 8 or 10 strips. Each one shows the short title and your number.
Press Download PDF to print, or Download PNG to share. Print at actual size and cut along the dotted lines.
features: The photo gets most of the space so people recognise it.
Opens a call, a WhatsApp chat or a web page.
Your number on 6 to 10 strips, turned sideways.
Red alert, yellow, blue, green and an ink-saving black and white.
Including Arabic and Urdu laid out right to left, Hindi and Chinese.
A4 and Letter PDF; square, portrait and story PNG.
Your poster is still there when you come back.

example.title: Example: a lost dog poster
example.text: Bella, a small brown dog, ran off near the north gate of the park on Friday evening. Maria chooses Lost, Pet and the red style, adds a photo, the description, "Central Park, North Gate", the date and 6:30 PM, a reward of 200 USD and her number +44 7700 900123. The A4 PDF has LOST in large letters, the photo, the details, the reward band, her number, a QR code that calls her and 8 tear-off strips.

tips: Use a recent photo where the face and any markings are easy to see.
Keep the description short: colour, size, collar or clothes and anything unusual.
Always type the country code (like +1 or +91) so WhatsApp and calls work for everyone.
Put posters at eye level near where it was last seen, at shops, vets and bus stops.
Post the PNG in local WhatsApp and social media groups as well as printing it.
If a person is missing, contact the police first and give them the poster too.
problems: It says some text does not fit
Shorten the description, or choose a taller size such as A4 or Portrait post.
Type a full phone number, or a web page address, and check the QR code setting is not "No QR code".
PDF is for paper. Choose A4 or US Letter as the size, or use Download PNG for social media.
HEIC photos from some iPhones cannot be read by every browser. Take a screenshot of the photo or set the camera to "Most Compatible".
The strips are hard to cut
Print at actual size (100%), not "fit to page", so the dotted lines stay straight.
